blinding: Expected labels, variant class and other reviewer answers omitted from the common prompt. Reviewer sees source and candidate. This is not human double-blinding.
reuse: All six source rules already exposed to PALO development; new candidates are same-family calibration. No independent holdout claim.
scoring: Detection is altered calls on six mutations; false alarms are altered calls on twelve faithful controls. Missing, uncertain and invalid answers remain in fixed assigned denominators and have separate counts. No majority vote replaces reference labels.
uncertainty: No confidence intervals or model ranking: one authored family and one reviewer pass cannot support population inference.
pipeline: Frozen inputs -> model review -> strict response validation -> draft-label comparison -> source-bound review export -> publication. This is the calibration harness, not an application ingestion/performance test.
cost_policy: No more than USD 40 cumulative account usage plus unknown reserve; initial Fable request bounded below USD 1; web subscriptions excluded from marginal API accounting.
